name: mirage
text: Change made for bid volume: I doubled how long a bid rests before it is re-posted (30 to 60 min), so fewer get pulled and re-posted each pass. I did not lower the 3-books-must-agree floor or the margin, because the data to prove that is safe is not there yet. Your phone's settings were not changed. Watch the resting count over the next while; if it is still low I'll look at the bids that drop off when the candidate list changes.
